#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264ad: valid lines with case as an argument (a continued line, after then as an argument, an array, a regex
# group), and an ordinary `if case` in "$(…)".
f=$1; k=$2
n="$(grep -c -w \
  case "$f")"
m="$(echo then case)"
m="$(w=(case when); echo "${w[0]}")"
m="$([[ $k =~ ^(case|switch)$ ]] && echo y)"
v="$(if case "$f" in *.json) true ;; *) false ;; esac; then echo "j"; fi)"
echo "$n $m $v"
